title: Dinqii Ragaa Callisu
intro: Seenaa gidduu seenummaa waaqummaa fiigichaan haguugame si qunnama. Oduu qophii dinqii fi ittisa afaan hin qabne kan yeroon sagalee dhageessisu. Qormaanni adda taʼe kun eenyu akka isa mudate saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Ergaan waaqaa na ajaa'ibsiise naaf dhufe
Sabni koo qulqullummaa koo gaafan daa'ima qabadhee deebi'u gaaffii keessa galche
Yeroo tokkoof dubbachuu irraa akkan soomu na ajajame
Burqaa bishaanii fi damee yeroo qormaata kootti na jiraachise
Gooftaan koo muka dinqisiisaa naaf raase
Ergamaan tokko bifa nama mudaa hin qabneen natti mul'ate

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Qulqullummaa koo kan mirkanaa’e yeroo ilmi koo daa’ima ta’e dubbatu ture
outcome.answer: Qulqullummaa koo kan mirkanaa’e yeroo ilmi koo daa’ima ta’e dubbatu ture

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
